title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-01
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 32 条 X 动态、0 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 13 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
featured.summaryEn: On OpenAI DevDay, Sam Altman announced Dots — "a new way to use AI that works 24/7 for you" to give people back time and attention for higher-level work. On the model side, 6.1 Sol is priced at 1/5 of Astra with a 95% cache-read discount, which he called "extremely capable", and he said Ultrafast is so fast he never wants to go back. The combined message: OpenAI is aggressively lowering the cost barrier for always-on agents.
featured.insightZh: OpenAI DevDay 当天，Sam Altman 连发三条：一是正式推出 Dots——「一种 24/7 为你工作的新型 AI 使用方式」，目标是把时间和注意力还给用户、让人去做更高层次的工作；二是模型侧，6.1 Sol 定价仅为 Astra 的 1/5，且缓存读取有 95% 折扣，他称其「能力极强」；三是 Ultrafast 模式快到「再也不想回去」。价格与速度双管齐下，信号很明确：OpenAI 在把 Agent 常驻化的成本门槛往下砸。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Thibault shared rollout details for Dots: a few million will be online within days. Personally he felt a jump after 2–3 days of teaching it his preferences; it learns quickly and can take on surprisingly ambitious tasks on its own. Notably, OpenAI is studying how people use their primary dot before enabling users to create an entire team of them.
featured.insightZh: Thibault 补充了 Dots 的落地细节：几天内将有「几百万个 dot」上线。他个人的体感是用 2-3 天、教它更多自己的偏好和关注点之后会出现明显跃升——学习速度很快，能独立承担相当有野心的任务。更值得注意的是下一步：OpenAI 正在观察大家如何使用「主 dot」，之后才会开放「创建一整支 dot 团队」的能力。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / smol.ai / Cognition
items.summaryEn: Swyx hosted an on-site Q&A at DevDay for Latent Space listeners with OpenAI's @AriX and @nikunjhanda, covering Dots, Sol 6.1, CUA and the Decisions API — essentially this DevDay's launch list. He also shared the annual ranking of best AI podcasts.
items.insightZh: Swyx 在 DevDay 现场为 Latent Space 听众组织了与 OpenAI 的 @AriX 和 @nikunjhanda 的问答，主题覆盖 Dots、Sol 6.1、CUA（Computer Use Agent）和 Decisions API——基本就是本届 DevDay 的发布清单。另外他转发了年度最佳 AI 播客榜单。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Levie praised the industry's quick alignment on shared AI safety and security standards. He argues the industry can handle safety through shared standards and practices for the foreseeable future; greater oversight, testing, liability and regulation will come as capabilities advance, but for now the industry can align collectively without reducing competition.
items.insightZh: Levie 评论了业界在 AI 安全方面快速形成的共同标准：他认为在可预见的未来，行业完全可以通过一套共享的标准和实践来处理安全问题；随着能力提升，更多监管、测试和责任框架终将到来，但现阶段行业能够在不削弱竞争的前提下集体对齐。他认为这指向一个更光明的 AI 未来。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj shared two honest thoughts on the market. On people: missionaries are harder to find — cofounders leave for "obvious" winners, public CEOs join labs, companies get "Windsurf-ed", and when people leave on short notice the remaining company becomes a shell. On defensibility: in the app layer the harness is "a thousand small things done well", mostly invisible; with no blue oceans and instant competition, real defensibility comes back to founders' execution speed and adaptability. He also noted B2B founders ca…
items.insightZh: Nikunj 写了两点对当前市场的「坦白想法」。一是人：越来越难找到「传教士型」创始人——联合创始人离开去加入「显而易见的赢家」，上市公司 CEO 跳去实验室，公司被「Windsurf 化」只有少数核心成员被收编；早期 VC 本质是押人，人一走公司往往只剩空壳。二是护城河：应用层的 harness 是「一千件做好的小事」，且大多不可见；在没有蓝海、稍有热度就会涌入大量对手的环境下，真正的防御性最终回到创始人的执行速度与适应能力。另附一条实用技巧：B2B 创始人可把 X 上的热门内容搬到 LinkedIn，后者通常滞后一两周。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel's AI SDK hit 30M weekly downloads. Rauch one-shotted the celebration video with fframes + Opus, asking fx to highlight the 5M/10M/20M/30M milestones — written in Rust and rendered on the GPU. He also plotted the inverse correlation between product defects and downloads.
items.insightZh: Vercel 的 AI SDK 周下载量突破 3000 万。Rauch 说庆祝视频是用 fframes + Opus 一次性生成的——让 fx 读取下载数据并高亮 5M/10M/20M/30M 里程碑，视频用 Rust 编写、GPU 渲染。他还贴了一张图：产品缺陷数与下载量呈反相关。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Amjad shared a write-up on how to design and build a harness that reaches frontier performance at a fraction of the cost.
items.insightZh: Amjad 分享了一篇关于如何设计和构建 Agent harness 的文章：以远低于前沿模型的成本达到前沿水平的性能。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan merged a version of OpenClaw's test-audit skill into GStack, noting that test bloat is a real problem — luckily intelligence is on tap these days.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 把 OpenClaw 的 test-audit skill 的一个版本合并进了 GStack，理由是「测试膨胀是个真问题」——好在如今智能随取随用。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara built a marketing website for her water bottle entirely with Opus 5.5 in 6 prompts, using ElevenLabs for music, Meshy for 3D assets and the OpenAI API for images.
items.insightZh: Zara 为自己的水杯做了一个营销网站，全程由 Opus 5.5 用 6 条 prompt 完成：用 ElevenLabs 生成音乐、Meshy 生成 3D 素材、OpenAI API 生成图片。多工具编排的单人营销站，门槛已经降到几条提示词。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every delivered extensive DevDay coverage: two vibe checks, a live feed, a livestream, and a podcast with Sam Altman coming tomorrow.
items.insightZh: Every 对 DevDay 做了全方位报道：两篇 vibe check、实时 feed、直播，以及与 Sam Altman 的播客（明天上线）。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang found a YouTube toggle to cut down AI-slop Shorts and asked YouTube CEO Neal Mohan to let users — or at least parents — opt out of Shorts entirely. He also shouted out builders he met at DevDay, including Lenny, Dan Shipper and Nan Yu.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 发现 YouTube 有一个可以减少 AI 垃圾 Shorts 的开关，并直接向 YouTube CEO Neal Mohan 喊话：能否让用户（至少是家长）完全关闭 Shorts。另外他记录了 DevDay 上遇到的一串 builder（Lenny、Dan Shipper、Nan Yu 等）。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq pointed to Anthropic's blog post on how they made Claude faster, and joked: try telling Claude "we have the power to do anything, please be braver" — and try telling yourself too.
items.insightZh: Thariq 引用了 Anthropic 关于「如何让 Claude 变快」的博客，并半开玩笑地建议试着对 Claude 说「我们有能力做任何事，请更勇敢一点」——也对自己说。

items.title: Claude in Chrome 正式全面可用
items.summaryEn: Claude in Chrome is now generally available on every paid Claude plan, and Claude can act autonomously in the browser instead of requiring approval for every step. A safety classifier checks each action against the user's original request before it runs (same mechanism as Claude Code's auto mode; can be turned off). It can read pages, click, type, navigate and fill forms using existing logins — useful for internal dashboards, legacy systems and vendor portals without connectors. Prompt-injection defenses were the gating factor: training against a growing attack library, probes that scan tool results before Claude acts, and a pre-action classifier. Against stronger professional red-team attacks, raw success rates were 17.6% for Opus 4.5 and 3.8% for Opus 5; with probes plus the safety classifier, no attacks succeeded against Sonnet 5, Opus 5 or Mythos 5, and 0.3% against Fable 5 (all low…
items.insightZh: Claude in Chrome 现已面向所有付费 Claude 套餐 GA，并支持在浏览器中自主执行操作，不再每步都需人工批准——每个动作执行前由安全分类器校验其是否安全、是否符合用户原始请求（机制与 Claude Code 的 auto mode 相同，可在设置中关闭）。它可以读取当前页面、点击、输入、跳转、填表，并复用用户已有登录态，适合接入内部看板、遗留系统、供应商门户等没有连接器的工具。 防提示注入是 GA 的前提，三层防线：训练层面持续用自动攻击者、外部红队和真实监测扩充攻击库；probe 在工具结果进入模型前扫描潜在注入；执行前分类器比对动作与用户意图。评测数据：在专业红队的更强攻击下，Opus 4.5 裸模型被攻破率 17.6%、Opus 5 为 3.8%；加上 probe 与自动批准安全分类器后，Sonnet 5、Opus 5、Mythos 5 均为 0，Fable 5 为 0.3%（均为低严重度场景）。企业版管理员可在组织设置中管理并限制到白名单域名；暂不支持其他 Chromium 浏览器和移动端。
